Container.Name: LivePoster
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: poster kaleidescape plex jellyfin movie display signage now playing tmdb
Container.Overview:
Turns any screen into a movie poster display for your home theatre. LivePoster watches your Kaleidescape, Plex and Jellyfin systems: when something is playing it shows that title's poster, tagline, rating and progress; when nothing is playing it cycles your library as a "Coming Soon" slideshow. Point a wall-mounted TV or tablet at it in kiosk mode.
Artwork and metadata come from TheMovieDB, with optional Rotten Tomatoes scores from OMDb. A built-in management UI lets you correct any title that matched the wrong film and exclude titles from the slideshow, and content filters keep chosen ratings off the screen.
REQUIRES a free TheMovieDB account - both the API Key and the API Read Access Token - plus at least one media system. The app starts without them and shows a setup screen telling you what is missing.
NOTE: LivePoster has no authentication. It is designed for a trusted home network; do not expose it to the internet.
Kaleidescape users: set the Player IP to the device that plays movies, and the Movie Server IP to the device that stores them (a Terra). On an all-in-one system such as a Strato V, set only the Player IP. Getting these backwards is the most common setup mistake - the slideshow works but "Now Playing" never appears. The container log says so explicitly if it detects it.
Container.Requires: A free TheMovieDB API key and read token. At least one of: Kaleidescape, Plex, or Jellyfin.
Container.Changes:
### 1.1.0 - Fixed a crash when the Kaleidescape player was unreachable or powered off - Startup no longer stalls waiting on an unreachable player; the cached library is served immediately - Fixed content-rating filtering, which silently hid TV-rated and unrated titles from the slideshow - Renamed KALEIDESCAPE_HOST/KALEIDESCAPE_HTTP_HOST to KALEIDESCAPE_PLAYER_HOST/KALEIDESCAPE_SERVER_HOST - API keys are no longer returned in full by the settings API - Added support for Docker secrets via the <NAME>_FILE convention
### 1.0.0 - Initial release

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores the metadata cache and any settings saved from the web UI. Keep this mapped or you re-scan your library on every update.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: TheMovieDB API Key (v3 auth). Free from themoviedb.org - Settings, API.

Config.Name: TMDb Read Access Token
Config.Description: TheMovieDB API Read Access Token (v4 auth), from the same page as the API key. Both values are required.

Config.Name: Kaleidescape Player IP
Config.Description: IP of your Kaleidescape PLAYER - the device that reports what is playing (e.g. 192.168.1.50). On an all-in-one system such as a Strato V, this is your only Kaleidescape setting.

Config.Name: Kaleidescape Movie Server IP
Config.Description: IP of the Kaleidescape MOVIE SERVER that stores your library, such as a Terra (e.g. 192.168.1.51). Leave blank if the player and server are the same device.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin server URL including port (e.g. http://192.168.1.61:8096)

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key, from Dashboard, API Keys

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Plex server URL including port (e.g. http://192.168.1.60:32400)

Config.Name: OMDb API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Adds Rotten Tomatoes scores. Free key from omdbapi.com.

Config.Name: Display Scale
Config.Description: Text scaling for the display, 0.5 to 3.0. Also adjustable live in the settings UI.

Config.Name: Poll Interval
Config.Description: How often to check for playback changes (milliseconds)

Config.Name: Slideshow Interval
Config.Description: How long each poster stays on screen when idle (milliseconds)
